title: How Crews Eat, Work & Hide Inside America's Nuclear Mountain Bunker
intro: Fifteen buildings on giant steel springs, hidden under granite behind 25-ton blast doors. Here's how the crews inside Cheyenne Mountain eat, work and stay sane.
asof_line: Figures come from US Air Force, Space Force and NORAD articles.
